Pune Global Service Centre FP&A Team India is growing as an Apex Group finance hub as it provides intelligent, enthusiastic, and energetic professionals to compliment a strong global finance team. This is a great opportunity to join the Global FP&A Team who have chosen Pune as their FP&A Global Service Centre (GSC). The FP&A Pune Team started with a 7-member team in 2021 in Phase 1. Following early successes of the Pune team and the need for increased reporting to stakeholders following a high number of recent business acquisitions, the team grew to 32 members by 2024 in the subsequent hiring phases. We now have a team of technically strong and energetic employees and middle management professionals delivering an increasing number of data sets, standardised deliverables, and improved analytical reporting to assist the Global FP&A team in managing reporting for the entire portfolio of Group Companies. The FP&A organisational structure is relatively flat thereby increasing opportunities for everyone to grow and build a successful career. We are looking to hire team members who will complement our world class high performing team. These roles are expected to drive data cleansing, standardised processing and be engaging with business, management, and finance teams across the globe. The Role This is an exciting opportunity for a Finance professional to join a high performing Global FP&A team operating in a fast growth Global Financial Services organisation. We have a few openings at Associate, Senior Associate, Assistant Vice President and Vice President and Senior Vice President Levels. The Global FP&A team is functionally structured with Group Reporting (which includes synergy reporting as well), Revenue, People Cost and Other Expense Reporting and Partnering as the main pillars who also play a major role in stake holder partnership and management. The Entire Team and each Pillar is led by extremely knowledgeable, experienced, dedicated, and professional leaders. Basis the specific function the activities may differ, but an overall list of activities covered under the various roles are as below: Close partnership with the FP&A Regional Finance, Business Leads and Cost Centre Owners Understand the main drivers while performing various activities under the different pillars (functions) of the Global FP&A Team to help perform better Perform and own day to day, monthly BAU activities and ad hoc requests Perform the Forecast and Planning activities Actual vs Plan Role Relocation / Target Operating Model Tracking Synergy Tracking Do a Deep dive analysis of the P&L with detailed commentary for various Stakeholders The Leadership team (Global FP&A) Group Segment / Product Leads and Group Regional Heads Group CFO Group COO Prepare Various trackers, Function basis detailed reports for further understanding Various datasets for Variance Analysis, various region / product wise datasets etc Assist the seniors in preparing various reports and dash boards (e.g: Reports related to Profitability, revenue growth, trend analytics etc) Help in improvisation and enhancement of existing Workday / Adaptive system Work within the team to create a robust team culture with proper back up for processes, SOP & documentation .

About Us

Wolters Kluwer is a global leader in professional information services, providing software and content solutions for legal, business, tax, accounting, finance, audit, risk, compliance, and healthcare professionals. Serving clients in over 180 countries with operations in 40+, the company helps professionals make confident decisions and drive results. Headquartered in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands, it employs around 21,000 people worldwide.

The Global Finance Shared Services (FSS) is a finance function designed to bring together finance and accounting professionals to streamline and enhance processes and tools. Within FSS, the Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Pune, India, provides centralized financial and analytical support across all Wolters Kluwer divisions. The team, comprising finance professionals and data scientists, focuses on finance reporting harmonization, technology enablement, and reporting and analytics enhancements.

In this role, you would support the Financial Shared Services (FSS) team with reporting, budgeting, and forecasting, while driving process improvements and strategic initiatives. You’d collaborate with finance leaders to enhance performance, provide insights across customer lifecycle processes, and develop revenue models to identify risks and opportunities. Additionally, you'd manage financial planning, reporting, and long-term strategy, with a strong focus on revenue and key performance metrics.

SUPERVISORY RELATIONSHIPS

Reports To : Manager, Finance COE

Job Qualifications
